text:
Amy S.: FYI support ticket #4521 from AcmeCorp just landed — they want the API to stream incremental function/tool calls with partial argument chunks and mid-stream structured events. customer is hitting latency limits with multipart payloads and wants to start acting on partial args before the full call completes. sample from ticket below.

Chun L.: @Amy S. can you paste the exact customer example? do they need schema validation within the stream or just line-delimited JSON events?

Amy S.: pasted snippet from customer (they asked to preserve formatting):
```
{"event":"call_start","fn":"getNearbyStores","call_id":"c-123"}
{"event":"arg_chunk","call_id":"c-123","payload":"{\"lat\":37.7,"}
{"event":"arg_chunk","call_id":"c-123","payload":"\"lng\":-122.4}
{"event":"call_end","call_id":"c-123"}
{"event":"tool_output","call_id":"c-123","status":"ok","result":{"stores":[{"id":1}]}}
```
They specifically said: "we need early tool routing — our fulfillment can start validating location chunks before full payload" and "we need deterministic framing so our parsers don't hang on partial json".

Leo M.: engineering notes: this is doable but touches streaming framing, parser semantics, and function-calling surface. options: 
1) minimal: accept newline-delimited JSON events (no schema enforcement). cheap to implement, easy to route.
2) framed events: add `event_type` + length prefix or explicit `end_of_field` marker. more robust for binary payloads.
3) extended function-calling: expose a first-class `call_session` stream object that maintains partial args and finalizes into a normal function-call invocation. largest surface area.
Costs/risks: batching/backpressure changes, KV cache semantics when we start executing on partial args, and potential regressions for existing streaming clients. estimate: option 1 = 1 sprint fixups; option 2 = 2-3 sprints + infra tests; option 3 = 3-5 sprints + cross-team API contract work.

Tara R.: model correctness note — partial-JSON streaming can produce invalid/incomplete tokens that trigger hallucination or malformed payloads on the model side. we need an eval harness that fuzzes partial-chunk sequences and validates final assembled arguments. also add a regression test that runs on top-traffic models to catch perf regressions.

Nisha K.: Sales: AcmeCorp is evaluating Dedicated for latency SLA. they flagged this as a blocker for pilot. high ARR potential if we ship a robust solution. legal and security want TLS-in-transit + audit logs preserved for these sessions.

Chun L.: Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
- product supports newline-delimited JSON event stream for function/tool calls (initial rollout = option 1)
- events include `event` (call_start|arg_chunk|call_end|tool_output) and `call_id` and are idempotent-safe
- SDKs (node/python) can rehydrate partial args client-side with >=95% success in fuzz tests
- no increase >5% in median latency for non-streaming completions in canary region
- security: stream events respect existing KMS and audit policies
Rollout plan: alpha with 2 customers (AcmeCorp + internal) -> gated canary -> GA.

Leo M.: I'll scope a spike to prototype newline-delimited approach + runtime hooks for early routing. will put up a draft PR/arch doc next week. blockers: need design for backpressure semantics when tool invocation triggers IO.

Amy S.: added ticket link to support case: https://redwood.support/tickets/4521 and attached the customer's parser code snippet.

Chun L.: I'll create a product backlog ticket with the acceptance criteria above and label it `priority:high-customer-driven`. tagging @leo @tara for engineering estimate in the ticket. Nisha, please confirm commercial push so we can prioritize contracts if needed.

Nisha K.: Confirmed — commercial is ready to escalate if engineering delivery can be within Q2.

infra-bot: New backlog issue created: RINF-8672 (partial-invoke-streaming) — link: https://redwood.internal/issue/RINF-8672

Chun L.: Thanks team — next step: engineering spike (assign to @Leo M.), draft spec (I'll take), and support will coordinate pilot customers. amy please add the raw logs and sample parser to the ticket. :thumbsup:
